title: HPV Vaccination Among Daughters of Latina Immigrants
brief_summary: The overall goal of this study to promote HPV vaccine uptake among daughters of Latina immigrants between the ages of 9 and 12.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Latina immigrant
* Resident of selected randomization unit (place of residence)
* 18 years of age and older
* At least one HPV unvaccinated daughter between the ages of 9 and 12

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
